claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 18650 1600mAh 15C as a 1600mAh preset with a 15C runtime rating.
The AW IMR 18650 1600mAh entry is documented with a red wrapper, button top, and a tested sample measuring 18.4 mm × 65.3 mm.

The AW IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AW IMR 18650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2012-02-04 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: The historical red button-top wrapper is documented, but no manufacturer verification path or batch-specific authenticity evidence was identified.
